name: claude-control
description: Manage persistent local Claude sessions from Codex with explicit models and verified results.

interface.shortDescription: Manage versioned local Claude sessions by role.
interface.longDescription: Manage and monitor local Claude sessions, task revisions, queues, bounded review workflows and explicit plan-edit-review compositions. Configure versioned models per role and inspect the signed-in Claude account's model catalog without exposing account identity. The read-only Rust viewer shows the live multi-agent graph, minimap, durable event replay, camera modes and agent details; the portable Python TUI remains available for account limits and fallback use. Observation history exports as OTLP JSON or streaming AG-UI events without prompt, reasoning or tool-call bodies. Workspace policies add controller-mediated edits, isolated named checks and frozen results for Codex approval. Linux and Windows are supported; Windows session control uses a pinned native helper and Windows workspaces use WSL2 with Bubblewrap. Native Claude tools and cross-host dispatch remain disabled.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Claude Control to delegate a local task and verify its result.
